purpose: Presentation-layer React component that surfaces this device's MLS identity (clientId, KP d-slot, per-relay event info) and observed sibling slots with group-membership flags inside the Settings modal's 'Identity' tab.

public_api.name: IdentityPanel
public_api.description: Renders the identity transparency panel. Returns null with a 'not signed in' placeholder when client or pubkey is absent from useMarmot(). All data is read exclusively via useMarmot() plus a relay request for sibling kind-30443 events.

dependencies_allowed: src/marmot/device-sync.ts (groupHasKeyPackageLeaf — type import and runtime call)
dependencies_forbidden: any toast/notification library not already in package.json
test_targets: IdentityPanel renders nothing / placeholder when client is null
IdentityPanel renders nothing / placeholder when pubkey is empty
Identity tab is present in SettingsModal alongside existing tabs
